title: API Keys
body: Bring your own keys. They are stored locally on this machine and never uploaded.
openrouterHint: One key, many cheap models (DeepSeek/GLM/MiniMax). Used by CI reviewers and OpenRouter agents.
openaiHint: Used only when an agent or feature uses an OpenAI model.
infoBox: Keys live in <path>file</path> on this machine. For CI, add the same key as a repository secret — see <github>GitHub Integration</github>.
